Rashid Khan Wins Telangana Open Golf After Seven-Year Drought

Golfer Rashid Khan secured victory at the Telangana Open 2026, concluding a seven-year wait for a title. He achieved a three-shot lead over his competitors to win the championship. The win marks a significant return to form for Khan after a prolonged period without a tournament victory.
